scope: bounded schema-based base generation with explicit strategies and rules
caller-owned typed pools, exact saved-plan binding and receipt-gated progress
real Equipment and Quantity trajectories through native redb services

environment.cargo_build: not run; no Rust source changed

commands.coverage: 8 semantic/contract controls and 2 real native workflows

commands.note: Combined client/model/N3 run; overlapping with the focused runs and not added to a unique test total.
Separate client/model verification after example status reconciliation.

steps: commit one Pool anchor and verify its exact committed receipt
use a custom typed selector and fresh client read to prepare and commit one Delivery
submit a Reservation from stale context and receive native invalid_input with no population advancement
retain the exact saved plan on an unknown outcome, reject plan rebinding, then reject only on the definite native no-commit response
read selected parent asynchronously and derive exact 24/12 rational target
concurrently update parent to '1000000000000000000'; native rejects Scale with overflow and state does not advance
restore Source to '12', derive exact 6/12 rational from fresh read, commit Scale, then commit Join
quantity.receipt_ids_checked: exact operation ID and ordered returned record IDs before state advancement

intermediate_failed_trials: undefined clock was included in strategy context
proposal fingerprint calculation included its own digest
implementation expected an extra result wrapper beyond the actual {status,result} client response
test expected stale error code instead of native overflow
one attempt-count assertion ran before accept
limitations: No global-validity guarantee; native validation and mutation remain authoritative.
Custom reference selection materializes compatible pool views and costs O(pool size) time and memory for that edge.
Generating n records has an O(n) lower bound; no constant-time generation claim is made.
Final full-suite stdout is retained; focused test stdout and raw receipt dumps were not retained.
